production_build.scope: same disposable source snapshot, with local .grok configuration excluded

repository_lint.notes: Existing warnings remain; no lint errors.

browser: Playwright Chromium; serial workers; local preview on port 8081
coverage: All six previously held commerce paths now use a pinned synthetic Ed25519 v2 watcher key and signed reports.
Watcher fixture assertions verify the derived bearer token is sent in Authorization and is absent from the URL.
Confirmed receipt control includes a signed chain timestamp at or after order address issuance.
Both database queued-write persistence races pass: close/reopen writes remain sealed, and a locked update merges and reseals without stale ciphertext or plaintext fields.
limits: The app was built as the UI-test artifact and served only from loopback.
Watcher responses, Ed25519 fixture key, accounts, and payment records are synthetic; no real watcher operator, chain RPC, relay, or buyer/vendor network flow was exercised.
This run is browser regression evidence, not a commerce release decision or production security proof.
